page.title: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous
page.subtitle_html: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous — Present Perfect = have / has + V3 для результату або факту зараз, а Present Perfect Continuous = have / has been + V-ing для процесу, тривалості або недавньої активності до теперішнього моменту.
page.subtitle_text: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous — Present Perfect = have / has + V3 для результату або факту зараз; Present Perfect Continuous = have / has been + V-ing для процесу, тривалості або недавньої активності до теперішнього моменту.
tags: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous
base_tags: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous

blocks.body: {"level":"A2–B1","intro":"Present Perfect usually answers what has happened or what is true now because of the action. Present Perfect Continuous usually answers what activity has been going on up to now or how long it has been happening.","rules":[{"label":"PRESENT PERFECT","color":"blue","text":"have / has + V3 for a finished result, experience, or a fact that matters now.","example":"I have lost my keys. / She has already finished."},{"label":"PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS","color":"emerald","text":"have / has been + V-ing for process, duration, or recent activity leading up to now.","example":"I have been looking for my keys for an hour. / She has been working all morning."},{"label":"KEY QUESTION","color":"violet","text":"Ask yourself: what has happened / what is true now? or how long / what has been going on up to now?","example":"finished result now / ongoing or recent activity up to now"}]}

{"title":"1. Швидке порівняння","intro":"Обидва часи поєднують минуле з теперішнім, але акцент різний:","rows":[{"en":"Present Perfect","ua":"результат, досвід або факт зараз","note":"I have just finished my homework."},{"en":"Present Perfect Continuous","ua":"процес або тривалість до теперішнього моменту","note":"I have been doing my homework for two hours."},{"en":"just / already / yet","ua":"часто ведуть до завершення або готового результату зараз","note":"She has already eaten. / Have you done it yet?"},{"en":"ever / never","ua":"життєвий досвід до теперішнього моменту","note":"Have you ever tried sushi? / I have never been there."},{"en":"for / since / how long","ua":"часто ведуть до тривалості й активності до теперішнього моменту","note":"How long have you been waiting?"},{"en":"lately / recently","ua":"часто ведуть до недавньої повторюваної або тривалої активності","note":"He has been sleeping badly lately."},{"en":"result now vs activity up to now","ua":"have / has + V3 vs have / has been + V-ing","note":"I have painted the door. / I have been painting the door."}],"warning":"Якщо дія вже завершена і важливий результат зараз, бери Present Perfect. Якщо важливі сама активність або тривалість до теперішнього моменту, бери Present Perfect Continuous."}

{"title":"2. Форми обох часів","intro":"Порівняй базові моделі для ствердження, заперечення і питання.","items":[{"label":"Present Perfect","title":"Affirmative","subtitle":"Subject + have / has + V3: I have finished."},{"label":"Present Perfect","title":"Negative","subtitle":"Subject + haven't / hasn't + V3: She hasn't finished yet."},{"label":"Present Perfect","title":"Question","subtitle":"Have / Has + subject + V3? Have you ever seen this film?"},{"label":"Present Perfect Continuous","title":"Affirmative","subtitle":"Subject + have / has been + V-ing: I have been studying."},{"label":"Present Perfect Continuous","title":"Negative","subtitle":"Subject + haven't / hasn't been + V-ing: He hasn't been sleeping well lately."},{"label":"Present Perfect Continuous","title":"Question","subtitle":"Have / Has + subject + been + V-ing? How long have you been waiting?"}]}

{"title":"3. Де акцент змінює вибір часу","sections":[{"label":"Результат зараз","color":"blue","description":"Бери Present Perfect, коли дія вже завершена і важливий готовий результат, кількість або факт зараз. Слова just, already і yet часто підказують саме це.","examples":[{"en":"I have just cleaned the kitchen.","ua":"Кухня вже чиста зараз."},{"en":"Have you written the email yet?","ua":"Ми питаємо, чи готовий результат до цього моменту."}]},{"label":"Досвід до теперішнього моменту","color":"violet","description":"Бери Present Perfect для життєвого досвіду з ever і never, коли точний час у минулому неважливий.","examples":[{"en":"Have you ever visited London?","ua":"Ми питаємо про досвід до теперішнього моменту."},{"en":"I have never ridden a horse.","ua":"Мова про відсутність досвіду до зараз."}]},{"label":"Процес і тривалість до теперішнього моменту","color":"emerald","description":"Бери Present Perfect Continuous, коли важливі процес або тривалість. Тут часто з'являються for, since, how long, lately і recently.","examples":[{"en":"I have been studying since 7 o'clock.","ua":"Процес почався раніше і триває до зараз."},{"en":"How long have they been waiting?","ua":"Питання прямо про тривалість."}]},{"label":"Та сама ситуація, інший акцент","color":"amber","description":"Контекст може бути схожим, але значення змінюється: готовий результат зараз або активність до теперішнього моменту.","examples":[{"en":"I have painted the room.","ua":"Кімната вже готова зараз."},{"en":"I have been painting the room for two hours.","ua":"Активність тривала до теперішнього моменту."}],"note":"Present Perfect часто відповідає на What has happened?, а Present Perfect Continuous частіше відповідає на What have you been doing? або How long?"}]}

{"title":"4. Типові помилки","items":[{"label":"Mistake 1","color":"blue","title":"Брати Present Perfect, коли процес ще не завершений і важлива тривалість","wrong":"❌ I have painted the wall since 10 o'clock.","right":"✅ I have been painting the wall since 10 o'clock."},{"label":"Mistake 2","color":"emerald","title":"Мішати форму Continuous з уже готовим результатом","wrong":"❌ I have been finished my homework.","right":"✅ I have finished my homework."},{"label":"Mistake 3","color":"violet","title":"Вживати форму Continuous з дієсловами стану","wrong":"❌ I have been knowing him for years.","right":"✅ I have known him for years."},{"label":"Mistake 4","color":"amber","title":"Вживати continuous для готової кількості або підрахунку","wrong":"❌ I have been writing three emails today.","right":"✅ I have written three emails today."}]}

{"title":"5. Дієслова стану і важлива примітка","items":["know, like, believe, understand, want і need зазвичай ідуть у Present Perfect, а не в Present Perfect Continuous.","Кажи I have known her for years, а не I have been knowing her for years.","for і since не автоматично означають continuous: зі станами ми часто беремо Present Perfect, наприклад We have lived here since 2020.","Для рівня A2–B1 тримай просте правило: state = Present Perfect, activity or process = Present Perfect Continuous."]}

{"title":"6. Короткий алгоритм вибору","items":["Потрібен готовий результат, кількість або завершений факт зараз → бери Present Perfect.","Є just, already, yet або життєвий досвід з ever / never → зазвичай бери Present Perfect.","Є питання how long?, маркери for / since або активність, що триває до зараз → бери Present Perfect Continuous.","Потрібно показати недавній процес із видимим результатом зараз → бери Present Perfect Continuous.","Якщо дієслово є дієсловом стану, залишайся з Present Perfect, навіть коли період тягнеться до теперішнього моменту."]}

page.title: Narrative Tenses: Past Simple, Past Continuous and Past Perfect
page.subtitle_html: Narrative tenses help tell a story in the past: Past Simple for main events, Past Continuous for background actions, and Past Perfect for actions that happened before another past moment.
page.subtitle_text: Narrative tenses help tell a story in the past: Past Simple for main events, Past Continuous for background actions, and Past Perfect for actions that happened before another past moment.

blocks.body: {"level":"B1","intro":"Use narrative tenses to make the order of past events clear in a story.","rules":[{"label":"PAST SIMPLE","color":"blue","text":"Use Past Simple for the main events in the story.","example":"The phone rang."},{"label":"PAST CONTINUOUS","color":"emerald","text":"Use Past Continuous for background actions or actions in progress.","example":"I was cooking dinner when the phone rang."},{"label":"PAST PERFECT","color":"violet","text":"Use Past Perfect for an action that happened before another past action.","example":"We had already left when the storm started."}]}

{"title":"1. Quick comparison","intro":"Choose the tense by the role of the action in the story.","rows":[{"en":"Past Simple","ua":"main event in the story","note":"She opened the door."},{"en":"Past Continuous","ua":"background action or action in progress","note":"She was walking home when it started to rain."},{"en":"Past Perfect","ua":"earlier action before another past action","note":"He had never flown before he went to Canada."},{"en":"when","ua":"often connects background and event","note":"I was reading when someone knocked."},{"en":"while","ua":"often connects two parallel background actions","note":"The children were playing while their parents were talking."},{"en":"before / after / already","ua":"often show past-before-past order","note":"After they had closed the shop, they went home."}],"warning":"Keep the function clear: main event, background action, or earlier past action."}

{"title":"2. Basic forms","intro":"These are the simple forms needed for B1 narrative tenses.","items":[{"label":"Past Simple","title":"Affirmative / negative / question","subtitle":"She opened the door. / He did not recognize me. / Did they find the bag?"},{"label":"Past Continuous","title":"Background action","subtitle":"I was cooking dinner. / They were watching TV. / Were you sleeping?"},{"label":"Past Perfect","title":"Earlier past action","subtitle":"We had already left. / We had not met before. / Had she left before you arrived?"}]}

{"title":"3. Decision guide","items":["If it is the next main event in the story, use Past Simple.","If it was already in progress at that moment, use Past Continuous.","If it happened before another past event, use Past Perfect.","Use when for a background action plus a shorter event.","Use while for two longer actions happening at the same time.","Use before, after and already when the order of past events matters."]}

{"title":"4. Common mistakes","items":[{"label":"Mistake 1","color":"blue","title":"Using Past Simple when the action was background","wrong":"❌ I cooked dinner when the phone rang.","right":"✅ I was cooking dinner when the phone rang."},{"label":"Mistake 2","color":"emerald","title":"Forgetting the earlier-past function of Past Perfect","wrong":"❌ We already left when the storm started.","right":"✅ We had already left when the storm started."},{"label":"Mistake 3","color":"violet","title":"Using Past Perfect without a clear earlier past action","wrong":"❌ Yesterday I had watched TV.","right":"✅ Yesterday I watched TV."}]}
